senses.definition: a member of a strictly orthodox Sunni Muslim sect from Saudi Arabia; strives to purify Islamic beliefs and rejects any innovation occurring after the 3rd century of Islam
examples: Osama bin Laden is said to be a Wahhabi Muslim

senses.definition: a conservative and intolerant form of Islam that is practiced in Saudi Arabia
examples: Osama bin Laden and his followers practice Wahhabism
